title: Final Value Lx
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate and state that <L_x> = 0.

title: Final Value Lx^2
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate and state that <L_x^2> = 1/2 [l(l + 1) - m^2] hbar^2.

title: Use of Commutator
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the commutation relation to find <L_x> using <L_y, L_z>.

title: Symmetry Argument
description: Important Criteria: The student should mention the symmetry in the x and y components when calculating <L_x^2>.

title: Operator Properties
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of the properties of Hermitian operators in their calculations.

title: Calculation Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors in applying the commutation relations or miscalculating <L_x>.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
